description: Batch sizes of the KernelBench level 2 problem 55 module (nn.Linear(32768, 32768), max_pool1d(2), sum, times 0.5). The original cases escalated the batch from 32 to 512; the performance cases extend it down to 4 (4 to 512, 128x). Every batch reads the 4 GiB weight, so even batch 4 takes about a millisecond. Batches 1, 3, 100 and 300 are correctness-only boundary shapes, covering each block-size bucket of the baseline.
